scope: All actual exercise units in the three permitted imported sources; 4Geeks remains link-only.

modules.title: Values, functions, unions, and tuples
modules.rationale: Learn to annotate working JavaScript before transforming types.
modules.entry_requirements: Basic JavaScript variables, functions, arrays, objects, conditions, and loops.

modules.title: Object models and class contracts
modules.rationale: Use interfaces and narrowing on concrete data before generic abstractions.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 01; distinguish values from their annotations.

modules.title: Generics, state, and input safety
modules.rationale: Preserve input/output relationships, then model tagged results and reusable guards.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 02; functions, tuple positions, and interface contracts.

modules.title: Utility types, async APIs, and declarations
modules.rationale: Apply reusable types to realistic API and library boundaries before rebuilding those types.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 03; generics, predicates, tagged unions, and callbacks.

modules.title: Building types from types
modules.rationale: Move from using utilities to implementing them; simple tuple operations precede recursive ones.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 04; keyof, indexed access, generic constraints, and utility-type use.

modules.title: Equality and special types
modules.rationale: Establish exact comparison and distribution behavior before membership, uniqueness, and modifier analysis.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 05; conditional types and the never result of filtering.

modules.title: Object transformations and fluent builders
modules.rationale: Progress from adding/removing fields through selective modifiers to stateful type accumulation.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 06; mapped types, exact equality, object intersections, and generic defaults.

modules.title: Recursive tuples and matrices
modules.rationale: Learn shrinking-input recursion, accumulators, counters, and exact element handling.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 07; variadic tuple syntax, conditional inference, and exact equality.

modules.title: Template literals and string transformations
modules.rationale: Start with local character changes, then add recursive scans, case conversion, and joins.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 08; infer, tuple counters, unions, and accumulators.

modules.title: Function transformations and higher-order APIs
modules.rationale: Reuse tuple/string operations at typed function boundaries, then tackle currying.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 09; parameter inference, tuple reversal, promises, literal inference, and string joins.

modules.title: Deep objects and schema-driven types
modules.rationale: Combine recursive mapping, key remapping, tuple transforms, and path parsing.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 10; string decomposition, recursive tuples, object merging, and function inference.

modules.title: String algorithms and parsers
modules.rationale: Build explicit parsing state and error cases before composing full route and JSON parsers.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 11; recursive strings, object construction, tuple joins, and optional keys.

modules.title: Type-level arithmetic and numeric algorithms
modules.rationale: Distinguish small tuple arithmetic from decimal-digit algorithms needed for large literals.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 12; tuple construction, literal parsing, recursion, counters, and equality.

modules.title: Union algebra and combinatorial generation
modules.rationale: Learn union replacement and intersection, then generate structured alternatives without losing distinct tuple elements.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 13; distributive conditionals, tuple recursion, exact identity, and set-like operations.

modules.title: Contextual this and constrained APIs
modules.rationale: Apply type transformations to framework-style APIs and compile-time constraints.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 14; intersections, deep mapping, equality, tuple uniqueness, and assertion functions. Read about contextual this and ThisType before the Vue tasks; read about unique symbols and branded types before the final four units.

modules.title: Recursive algorithm applications
modules.rationale: Apply recursion and matrix techniques to complete algorithmic contracts.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 15; recursive tuples, matrix traversal, comparisons, and uniqueness checks.

modules.title: Compiler limits and advanced parameter shapes
modules.rationale: Finish with scaling constraints and combinations of optional and rest parameter positions.
modules.entry_requirements: Complete module 16; accumulator design, string counting, signed literal handling, parameter tuples, and compiler diagnostics.

units.title: Basic types
units.objective: Annotate a name, birth year, computed age, string array, object, and greeting function.

units.title: Function contracts
units.objective: Type arithmetic functions, optional/default/rest parameters, callbacks, void, and functions that never return.

units.title: Unions and narrowing
units.objective: Model identifiers and literal states; narrow with typeof and an exhaustive direction switch.

units.title: Tuples, readonly arrays, enums, and const assertions
units.objective: Model coordinates, calculate distance, sum readonly prices, derive a direction union, and use a numeric enum.

units.title: Interfaces and dictionaries
units.objective: Model products, optional and readonly properties, interface extension, and string-keyed lookup.

units.title: Type the community user model
units.objective: Define User from the supplied data and consistently type the array and logging function.

units.title: Unite users and administrators
units.objective: Define Person as a union and update consumers to accept both member shapes.

units.title: Narrow by property presence
units.objective: Repair logging so occupation and role are accessed only on the correct union branch.

units.title: Classes and inheritance
units.objective: Implement private state, getters, constructor properties, interface contracts, and an abstract base class.

units.title: Generic functions and indexed access
units.objective: Write identity, safe first-element access, constrained comparison, and a key-dependent property getter.

units.title: Swap a generic pair
units.objective: Type swap so unrelated inputs return a correctly reversed tuple without losing either type.

units.title: Discriminated unions and exhaustive handling
units.objective: Model shapes, compute areas, enforce exhaustive switches, and define and unwrap Result<T>.

units.title: Unknown, predicates, and assertion functions
units.objective: Wrap JSON parsing as unknown, narrow inputs, write a custom guard, assert numbers, and distinguish dates, lists, and strings.

units.title: Carry narrowing across function calls
units.objective: Give isUser and isAdmin explicit predicate contracts and use them in filtering and logging.

units.title: Built-in utilities and a first mapped type
units.objective: Derive update and public-user shapes, build a role-permission record, and implement MyPartial.

units.title: Flexible user filtering
units.objective: Accept partial user criteria without duplicating fields; include the bonus that excludes the type discriminator.

units.title: Overload a person filter
units.objective: Tie the discriminator, allowed criteria, and result array together; also implement the typed-keys bonus.

units.title: Compose a power-user type
units.objective: Combine user and administrator fields while replacing their incompatible discriminator.

units.title: Generic API responses
units.objective: Replace duplicate callback response shapes with one reusable tagged ApiResponse<T>.

units.title: Typed asynchronous code
units.objective: Implement delay, fetch one or many profiles, and return a typed Result from an async boundary.

units.title: Promisify callbacks
units.objective: Convert success/error callbacks into typed promises; include the object-wide promisifyAll bonus after the mapped-type introduction in B9.

units.title: Declare a JavaScript string library
units.objective: Inspect the bundled str-utils implementation and write its ambient declarations with a shared function alias.

units.title: Declare generic statistics operations
units.objective: Type comparator-based index/element operations and averaging, retaining empty-input nullability and shared aliases.

units.title: Augment an existing module
units.objective: Extend date-wizard with time fields and pad while preserving its existing callable namespace API.

units.title: Mapped, conditional, inferred, and template types
units.objective: Implement readonly and mutable mappings, non-nullable filtering, element inference, and the EventName bonus.

units.title: Hello World
units.objective: Replace the placeholder with string and learn how Equal, Expect, and NotAny enforce a type contract.

units.title: Tuple to Object
units.objective: Turn a readonly tuple of legal property keys into a key-to-itself object type.

units.title: If

units.title: Exclude

units.title: Pick
units.objective: Select specified object keys and reject invalid key selections.

key_dependencies.reason: never and callbacks precede exhaustive tagged-result handling
interfaces precede implements
generic functions precede Result<T>
predicates precede reusable filter guards
Partial and Omit precede partial criteria
single-branch filtering precedes overloaded filtering
callback response contracts precede promisification
promise fundamentals precede callback adapters
simple ambient declarations precede generic ones
declarations precede module augmentation
mapped types precede their independent readonly implementation
exact equality precedes membership
full readonly precedes selective readonly
